challenges_and_limitations.title: Severe Shadows & Lighting Transitions
challenges_and_limitations.description: High-contrast tree or building shadows cast across empty asphalt can exhibit high edge gradients, occasionally testing boundary discernment under extreme sun angles.

challenges_and_limitations.title: Partial Vehicle Occlusion
challenges_and_limitations.description: Taller SUVs or commercial vans in foreground slots can partially occlude background slots from oblique camera perspectives.

challenges_and_limitations.title: Weather & Lens Artifacts
challenges_and_limitations.description: Heavy rainfall, surface puddling causing specular reflections, and lens water droplets degrade image contrast relative to sunny baseline imagery.

challenges_and_limitations.title: Camera Angle Transferability
challenges_and_limitations.description: Slot coordinate mappings are tied to a fixed perspective. Changing camera mount angle or focal length requires re-annotation of slot coordinates via the picker utility.
